cases.name: Tamika S. Turks
cases.narrative:
On 6/19/1984, her partially decomposed body was found.

Tamika Turks age 7, years old and her 9 year old niece, Annie (who survived), were walking back from the candy store to their home when they were confronted by Debra Denise Brown and Alton Coleman.

Brown and Coleman convinced them to walk into the woods to play a game. Once there, they removed Tamika's shirt and tore it into small strips which they used to bind and gag the children. When Tamika began to cry, Brown held her nose and mouth while Coleman stomped on her chest.

She was victimized sexually by both Brown and Coleman. Brown and Coleman then choked her until she was unconscious. When she awoke, they were gone. Tamika was found dead in the bushes in Gary, IN, strangled with an elastic strip of bedsheet. The same fabric was later found in the apartment shared by Coleman and Brown.

cases.name: Mary A. "Unkin" Rawson
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Unkin loved working with people so much, she chose a career in the hospitality industry where she worked at Miller Beach Café. To know Unkin was to love Unkin and her life made an impact on the lives of everyone she came in contact with. Unkin was outgoing, funny, feisty, hard working, your ride or die and extremely intelligent. In her free time, Unkin enjoyed going to bingo, casino and fishing. Unkin loved her sons and family so much that there was nothing that she wouldn't do for them."
cases.narrative: Multiple stab wounds to the torso & white cord was also wrapped tightly around her neck.
